identity.name: enforcer
identity.oneLiner: Fire a lifecycle reminder when the session turn count signals hygiene matters — never block Stop.
constraints: Must never block the Stop event.
Must fire at most once per session (fire-once marker).
Must not re-fire after marker written.
Must not infer task completion or auto-clear.

partyInterface.produces: hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext nudge pointing at Steward lever router

rigor.grounding: Internal ccusage baseline: sessions >100 turns ≈ 92% of tokens; turn count is a proxy, not a task-boundary detector.
rigor.calibration: CE-04-clear-default, CE-05-router-gate (behavioral outcome of Enforcer nudge → Steward lever-router invocation); hook firing verified by 24-scenario test suite
